svg.text: (a) Positive, PAD to DVSS and PAD to DVDD
output NMOS, the same drains as the NMOS
drain diode: snaps back above 10.7 V
(Positive, PAD to DVSS), from each drain
to the sources beside it, on DVSS
PMOS drain: from the P+ drains, on PAD, into
the N-well and out through its N+ guard ring
on DVDD. To DVSS, on through the rail clamp

g.text: (b) Negative, PAD to DVSS and PAD
to DVDD: the NMOS drivers of (a)
NMOS drain: from the P+ guard ring on
DVSS into the N+ drains, on PAD. From
DVDD, first through the rail clamp to DVSS

svg.text: output NMOS and NMOS drain diode: the same drains
PMOS drains avalanche above 9.7 V (Negative, PAD to DVDD): second path, not drawn
rail clamp: in the supply pads, not here
